threads.author: Kailyn Jelniker
threads.summary: Welltower is signing a new UK contract and wants the existing custom Jotform to add a required Region selector (North America / UK) that routes jobs to the right Welltower MP client, filters property locations, and switches area units between sq ft and sq m.
threads.note: Snehal asked Kailyn (Mon 11/2) whether the UK property list should be grouped by State or by operator; Kailyn owes the answer.
